With permission, your app can use data from workout zones to provide a view of training intensity across all of a person’s workout apps.
Before you can access someone’s workout zone data, you must ask their permission.
You don’t need to call any additional methods to enable zone calculation.
Cycling power requires the person’s configuration.
Workouts can use different zone configurations, and comparing time-in-zone across workouts requires planning for those differences.
Use this information to update your interface and provide real-time feedback during workouts.
Custom configurations apply only to the workout created; they don’t modify the person’s preferred zone choices in Health Settings.
If you don’t set a custom configuration, the system uses the person’s preferred zones for zone calculations.
Apps that support reproductive health tracking can use HealthKit to record and query information about whether a person reports a menopausal or nonmenopausal state.
The framework requires that the start date and end date of each sample be identical.
Use the value to record when someone confirms that they have neither menopause nor perimenopause at a specific date.
Apps can use menopausal state information to personalize someone’s experience.

For example, when a group of friends joins a daily step-counting challenge, each person can use their preferred hardware device and app to track their steps, while everyone in the group uses the same social app for the challenge.
Because health data may contain sensitive, personal information, apps must receive permission from the user to read data from or write data to the HealthKit store.
They must also take steps to protect that data at all times.

By setting up the queries in , you ensure that you’ve instantiated your queries, and they’re ready to use before HealthKit delivers the updates.
After your observer queries have finished processing the new data, you must call the update’s completion handler.
If you don’t call the update’s completion handler, HealthKit continues to attempt to launch your app using a backoff algorithm to increase the delay between attempts.
